__doc__: Observability dashboard TEMPLATE for the Blockchain Integration Service and Dashboard. Grafana-compatible dashboard model (schemaVersion 39). MATURITY: this template is DESIGNED. Panels marked 'Designed' depend on capabilities that are absent today (correlation-ID middleware, OpenTelemetry tracing, /metrics, /health, /ready). Panels marked 'Implemented (reused)' bind to signals that are emitted today (gin.Logger/gin.Recovery access+panic logs; tasks logger.Error worker logs to stdout), with the caveat that pkg/logger is imported but absent (Source: backend/cmd/server/main.go:L10). See docs/operations/observability.md (Fig O1) and docs/operations/runbook.md. Grounded in documentation/Technical Specifications.md (THIRD-PARTY SERVICES: Amazon CloudWatch) and AAP Observability rule (0.10.3).
title: Blockchain Integration Service - Observability (Template)

panels.title: Liveness /health (Designed)
panels.description: Maturity: Designed. Binds to a /health endpoint that does not exist yet (Source: backend/internal/api/routes.go:L9-L54 defines no health route). Also needs a Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK (Source: infrastructure/docker/Dockerfile.backend:L20 - absent).

panels.title: Readiness /ready - PostgreSQL + Redis (Designed)
panels.description: Maturity: Designed. A /ready check should assert DB and cache reachability. Liveness primitives already exist to build on: db.Ping (Source: backend/internal/db/postgres.go:L27) and redisClient.Ping (Source: backend/internal/db/redis.go:L21).

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate by route (Designed)
panels.description: Maturity: Designed. Requires a /metrics endpoint exporting Gin request counters; no /metrics route exists today (Source: backend/internal/api/routes.go:L9-L54). The 18 routes are grouped under /auth, /vault, /transactions, /signatures (Source: backend/internal/api/routes.go:L17-L52).

panels.title: HTTP p95 Latency (Designed)
panels.description: Maturity: Designed. Requires /metrics request-duration histograms (absent). Target capacity per design is 10,000 req/s (Source: documentation/Technical Specifications.md:SYSTEM OVERVIEW).

panels.title: Worker Errors - transaction + signature processors (Implemented, reused)
panels.description: Maturity: Implemented (reused, emission-only). Binds to structured worker logs emitted via logger.Error in the processors (Source: backend/internal/tasks/transaction_processor.go:L26,L44,L50,L57; backend/internal/tasks/signature_processor.go:L25,L42,L48,L53,L57). Caveat: pkg/logger is imported but absent (Source: backend/cmd/server/main.go:L10), and there is no aggregation today - logs go to stdout.

panels.title: Settlement Lag - pending transaction age (Designed)
panels.description: Maturity: Designed. Approximates time transactions remain in status Pending before the transaction processor moves them to Processed (Source: backend/internal/core/transaction/service.go:L46,L81). The processor cannot run today: transactionCheckInterval is uninitialized so time.NewTicker(0) panics (Source: backend/internal/tasks/transaction_processor.go:L13-L16). See runbook.md.

panels.title: Signature Processor Poll Interval (Implemented = 5m)
panels.description: Maturity: Implemented. The signature processor polls on a fixed 5-minute ticker (Source: backend/internal/tasks/signature_processor.go:L13 const signatureCheckInterval = 5 * time.Minute). Shown for reference; a Designed metric would confirm last successful poll.

panels.title: Distributed Trace Error Rate (Designed)
panels.description: Maturity: Designed. Requires OpenTelemetry tracing across service boundaries (absent today). Would surface cross-service error spans (handler -> core service -> custodian/blockchain adapters). See Fig O1 in observability.md.
